name: South Africa
summary: Southern African economic hub heavily reliant on Mpumalanga coalfields for power generation. Pursuing Just Energy Transition Partnership while confronting industrial airshed pollution and water scarcity.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 4.92x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Highveld Priority Area records elevated industrial particulate levels.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; recurrent severe multi-year meteorological droughts across Cape and Karoo basins.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across southern African stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.1% share of global fossil emissions; highest emitter on the African continent.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Substantially above African average; driven by coal-fired electricity generation and synthetic fuel synthesis.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Mainly savanna woodlands and commercial pine/eucalyptus plantations; native closed forest is under 1%.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Rapid renewable independent power producer expansion; wind (4.8%) and solar (4.4%) displacing aged coal baseload.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 50 people/km²; urban population fraction is 68.3%.
